_note: SYNTHETIC demo vault: 150 hand-written example entries generated by tools/make-sample-vault.mjs, not anyone's real usage. Load it from Settings → Sync & data → Load sample vault. Tags are rebuilt from the expressions on import.

expressions.example_src: Can I borrow your drill this weekend?
expressions.example_parallel: Charge the drill before you start. — 先把电钻充上电。

expressions.gloss_cn: 个例的、道听途说的（不是系统数据）
expressions.example_src: The evidence is mostly anecdotal.
expressions.example_parallel: Anecdotal evidence isn't proof. — 个例不等于证据。

expressions.gloss_cn: 突然不回消息、人间蒸发
expressions.example_src: We went on three dates and then he ghosted me.
expressions.example_parallel: Don't ghost people, just say you're not interested. — 别玩消失，直说没兴趣就行。

qa_log.q: ghost 当动词是什么意思？和 block 有什么区别？
qa_log.a: ghost 是不解释地停止回复，人还在好友列表里；block 是直接拉黑。ghost 多用在约会和求职里。

expressions.example_src: It's just a drizzle, you don't need an umbrella.
expressions.example_parallel: Light drizzle all afternoon. — 一下午都在飘毛毛雨。

expressions.gloss_cn: 不在办公室、休假中（out of office）
expressions.example_src: I'm OOO until Monday.
expressions.example_parallel: She's OOO, try her backup. — 她休假了，找她的备岗。

expressions.example_src: We're over time, let's wrap it up.
expressions.example_parallel: Can you wrap it up in two minutes? — 两分钟内收个尾？

expressions.example_src: The movie was mid, honestly.
expressions.example_parallel: Everyone hyped it up but it's mid. — 大家吹得很凶，其实一般。

expressions.example_src: Sorry about the bedhead, I just woke up.
expressions.example_parallel: Bedhead, but make it fashion. — 睡乱的头发，硬说是造型。

expressions.example_src: It's so muggy today, my shirt is stuck to me.
expressions.example_parallel: Muggy and gross out there. — 外面又闷又黏。

expressions.gloss_cn: 有点儿、暗暗地（把语气压低）
expressions.example_src: I lowkey want to skip the party.
expressions.example_parallel: Lowkey, this song is kind of good. — 说实话这歌还挺好听。

qa_log.q: lowkey 放句首和句中有区别吗？
qa_log.a: 意思差不多，都是“有点、偷偷地”。放句首更像在坦白，放形容词前更像在弱化程度。

expressions.example_src: I crammed the whole textbook the night before.
expressions.example_parallel: Cramming never works for math. — 数学靠突击没用。

expressions.example_src: She's an early bird, up at five every day.
expressions.example_parallel: Early bird gets the parking spot. — 早到的人才有车位。

expressions.example_src: She set a personal record in the 5K.
expressions.example_parallel: Beating your personal record takes patience. — 破个人纪录要耐心。

expressions.example_src: Do we even own a plunger?
expressions.example_parallel: Grab the plunger, the toilet's clogged. — 拿搋子来，马桶堵了。

expressions.example_src: It's a bit nippy this morning, grab a jacket.
expressions.example_parallel: Nippy out, wear a layer. — 外面有点凉，加件衣服。

expressions.example_src: My screen protector cracked but the screen is fine.
expressions.example_parallel: Get a screen protector before you drop it. — 摔之前先贴个膜。

expressions.example_src: Cereal is BOGO this week.
expressions.example_parallel: Stock up, it's BOGO. — 囤点，买一送一。

expressions.gloss_cn: 必须准点结束（后面还有事）

expressions.example_src: Hit a new deadlift PR today.
expressions.example_parallel: That's a PR by ten pounds! — 比之前最好成绩多了十磅！

expressions.gloss_cn: 怎么都压不下去的那撮翘毛
expressions.example_src: I can't get this cowlick to lie flat.
expressions.example_parallel: Every photo, the same cowlick. — 每张照片都是那撮呆毛。

expressions.example_src: DM me the link.

expressions.intent_cn: 写作里说减轻某种影响

expressions.example_src: Use the ladle, not a mug, to serve the soup.
expressions.example_parallel: The ladle's in the dishwasher. — 汤勺在洗碗机里。

expressions.example_parallel: There's a race condition in the cache layer. — 缓存层有竞态。

expressions.example_src: That email looks sus, don't click it.
expressions.example_parallel: He's acting kind of sus. — 他有点鬼鬼祟祟的。

expressions.example_src: It was sweltering in the subway.
expressions.example_parallel: A sweltering 105 degrees. — 105 华氏度，热炸了。

expressions.example_src: My foot's all pins and needles from sitting cross-legged.
expressions.example_parallel: I've got pins and needles in my hand. — 我手麻了。

expressions.example_src: brb, pizza's here
expressions.example_parallel: brb, charging my phone. — 等下回来，充个电。

expressions.example_src: She aced the exam.
expressions.example_parallel: You're going to ace it. — 你肯定考得很好。

expressions.example_src: I twisted my ankle stepping off the curb.
expressions.example_parallel: Careful on those stairs, you'll twist your ankle. — 楼梯小心，别崴了脚。

expressions.example_src: To be honest, I'd rather stay home.
expressions.example_parallel: To be honest, it wasn't my idea. — 老实说这不是我的主意。

expressions.example_src: Rerun it, that's a flaky test.
expressions.example_parallel: Quarantine the flaky tests. — 把不稳定的测试先隔离。

expressions.example_src: Turn the bass down, the neighbors are complaining.
expressions.example_parallel: He plays bass in a band. — 他在乐队弹贝斯。

expressions.example_src: Great sesh today, legs are dead.
expressions.example_parallel: Quick sesh before work? — 上班前练一会儿？

expressions.example_src: We had a pop quiz in bio today.
expressions.example_parallel: Pop quiz, everyone put your phones away. — 突击测验，手机都收起来。

expressions.gloss_cn: 老出小毛病、时不时抽风
expressions.example_src: The app's been glitchy since the update.
expressions.example_parallel: My screen gets glitchy when it's cold. — 天一冷我屏幕就抽风。

expressions.example_src: I pulled an all-nighter to finish the deck.
expressions.example_parallel: Never again, all-nighters wreck me. — 再也不通宵了，太伤了。

expressions.example_src: He's got zero rizz but somehow it works.
expressions.example_parallel: Bro has unspoken rizz. — 这哥们不用开口就有魅力。

expressions.example_src: Social media is a double-edged sword.
expressions.example_parallel: Technology is a double-edged sword. — 科技是一把双刃剑。

expressions.gloss_cn: 我觉得、依我看（in my opinion）
expressions.intent_cn: 发消息时表明是个人看法
expressions.example_src: The first one's better imo.
expressions.example_parallel: imo you should take the job. — 我觉得你该接这份工作。

expressions.example_src: He got really buff over the summer.
expressions.example_parallel: You're looking buff these days! — 最近练得挺壮啊！

expressions.example_src: I think I pulled a muscle in my back.
expressions.example_parallel: Warm up first or you'll pull something. — 先热身，不然会拉伤。

expressions.example_src: I'm just having leftovers for lunch.
expressions.example_parallel: Leftover pizza is better cold. — 剩披萨凉着吃更香。

expressions.gloss_cn: 会议待办，分到人的任务
expressions.example_src: Let's go over the action items before we hang up.
expressions.example_parallel: Who owns the action items? — 这些待办谁负责？

expressions.example_src: I'm totally fried after that meeting marathon.
expressions.example_parallel: My brain is fried, explain it tomorrow. — 脑子烧了，明天再讲。

expressions.example_src: That's a plausible explanation, but we need evidence.
expressions.example_parallel: A plausible but untested theory. — 合理但没验证过的理论。

expressions.intent_cn: 要能稳定复现 bug 的步骤
expressions.example_src: Can you send me a minimal repro?
expressions.example_parallel: No repro, no fix. — 复现不了就没法修。

expressions.example_src: Want to split the bill?
expressions.example_parallel: Let's split it three ways. — 三个人平摊吧。

expressions.example_src: Students must strike a balance between study and rest.
expressions.example_parallel: Strike a balance between work and life. — 在工作和生活间找到平衡。

expressions.example_src: My hairline is creeping back.
expressions.example_parallel: Receding hairline at 25. — 25 岁发际线就后移了。

expressions.gloss_cn: 关不紧一直滴水的水龙头
expressions.example_src: That leaky faucet kept me up all night.
expressions.example_parallel: Text the landlord about the leaky faucet. — 跟房东说一下水龙头漏水。

expressions.example_src: It's six, let's call it a day.
expressions.example_parallel: We're not getting anywhere, let's call it a day. — 没进展了，收工吧。

expressions.example_src: That was the best burger I've ever had, no cap.
expressions.example_parallel: No cap, I finished it in an hour. — 真没吹，我一小时就搞定了。

expressions.example_src: The update failed and my phone is bricked.
expressions.example_parallel: Don't unplug it mid-update or it'll get bricked. — 更新到一半别拔，会变砖。

expressions.example_src: I got this jacket on clearance for twelve bucks.
expressions.example_parallel: Check the back, that's where the clearance stuff is. — 去后面看看，清仓的都在那。

expressions.example_src: Merge left, the lane ends.
expressions.example_parallel: Nobody would let me merge. — 没人让我并道。

expressions.example_src: The soup is way too salty.
expressions.example_parallel: Go easy on the soy sauce, it's already salty. — 酱油少放，已经够咸了。

expressions.gloss_cn: 看着没问题（looks good to me，代码评审用）
expressions.example_src: LGTM, ship it.
expressions.example_parallel: LGTM after the rename. — 改完名就可以合了。

expressions.example_src: I almost flunked chemistry.
expressions.example_parallel: If I flunk this, I'm retaking it in summer. — 挂了就得暑假重修。

expressions.gloss_cn: 会后单独聊（别在会上展开）

expressions.example_parallel: Good point, let's take it offline. — 好问题，会后单聊。

expressions.example_src: Dump the pasta into the colander.
expressions.example_parallel: Rinse the berries in a colander. — 用沥水篮冲一下莓子。

expressions.example_src: Everyone's on edge waiting for the layoff news.
expressions.example_parallel: Too much coffee puts me on edge. — 咖啡喝多了就心神不宁。

expressions.gloss_cn: 拼车（同事或家长轮流开）
expressions.example_src: We carpool to work on Mondays.
expressions.example_parallel: Want to carpool? — 一起拼车？

expressions.intent_cn: 说看到的只是一小部分

expressions.example_parallel: That's only the tip of the iceberg. — 这只是冰山一角。

expressions.gloss_cn: 会一直存在下去，不是一阵风

expressions.example_src: Remote work is here to stay.
expressions.example_parallel: Online learning is here to stay. — 网课会长期存在。

expressions.gloss_cn: 转接头（Type-C 转 HDMI 那种）

expressions.example_parallel: I own more dongles than cables now. — 我现在转接头比线还多。

expressions.example_src: We're penny-pinching until payday.
expressions.example_parallel: Stop penny-pinching, it's two dollars. — 别抠了，才两块钱。

expressions.example_src: Can you send it by EOD?
expressions.example_parallel: I'll have it to you EOD. — 下班前给你。

expressions.example_src: There's a trade-off between speed and accuracy.
expressions.example_parallel: Every design is a trade-off. — 每个设计都是取舍。

expressions.gloss_cn: 非常明显地、毫不掩饰地
expressions.example_src: I highkey need a nap.
expressions.example_parallel: Highkey obsessed with this show. — 我是真的迷上这剧了。

expressions.note: 和音乐的 bass 拼写一样，读音不同
expressions.example_src: We grilled some sea bass for dinner.
expressions.example_parallel: Pan-seared bass with lemon. — 香煎柠檬鲈鱼。

expressions.example_src: The grout in the shower is turning black.
expressions.example_parallel: Scrub the grout with an old toothbrush. — 用旧牙刷刷瓷砖缝。

expressions.example_src: I slept funny and woke up with a stiff neck.
expressions.example_parallel: Stiff neck again? Your pillow's too high. — 又落枕了？枕头太高了。

expressions.gloss_cn: 刮柠檬皮屑（只刮黄色那层）
expressions.example_src: Zest the lemon before you juice it.
expressions.example_parallel: Don't zest too deep, the white part is bitter. — 别刮太深，白色那层是苦的。

expressions.example_src: I feel groggy if I nap too long.
expressions.example_parallel: Still groggy, give me ten minutes. — 还没醒透，给我十分钟。

expressions.example_src: Running the microwave and the heater together trips the breaker.
expressions.example_parallel: The breaker tripped, so the whole kitchen is dark. — 跳闸了，厨房全黑。

expressions.example_src: I splurged on good headphones.
expressions.example_parallel: It's your birthday, splurge a little. — 生日嘛，奢侈一下。

expressions.note: 美式口语，英国人基本不这么说
expressions.example_src: I got a charley horse in the middle of the night.
expressions.example_parallel: Stretch your calf when you get a charley horse. — 抽筋了就拉伸小腿。

qa_log.q: charley horse 为什么叫这个名字？正式场合能用吗？
qa_log.a: 来源说法不一，跟棒球场上的跛脚老马有关。它是美式口语，跟医生说可以直接用 a cramp in my calf。

expressions.example_src: Three coffees and now I'm wired at midnight.
expressions.example_parallel: Too wired to sleep. — 兴奋得睡不着。

expressions.example_src: Let's just get takeout tonight.
expressions.example_parallel: Thai takeout again? — 又点泰餐外卖？

expressions.example_src: I'm completely burnt out after this quarter.
expressions.example_parallel: Take a week off before you burn out. — 趁还没倦怠先休一周。

expressions.example_src: Feed me before I get hangry.
expressions.example_parallel: Sorry I snapped, I was hangry. — 抱歉凶你了，饿急眼了。

expressions.example_src: Don't take the 405 at rush hour.
expressions.example_parallel: Rush hour traffic is brutal. — 高峰期堵得要命。

expressions.gloss_cn: 证实、佐证（用别的证据支持）
expressions.example_src: The second study corroborates these findings.
expressions.example_parallel: No data corroborates his claim. — 没有数据支持他的说法。

expressions.example_src: "Pick you up at seven?" "Bet."
expressions.example_parallel: Bet, see you there. — 行，那边见。

expressions.gloss_cn: 回头再说、之后再跟进（职场话术）
expressions.intent_cn: 说之后再回到这个话题
expressions.example_src: Let's circle back on this next week.
expressions.example_parallel: I'll circle back once I hear from legal. — 等法务回复我再跟进。

qa_log.q: circle back 和 follow up 有什么区别？
qa_log.a: follow up 是主动追进度；circle back 更像“这个先放一放，之后再回来谈”，常用来在会上暂时搁置话题。

expressions.identity: 美国马萨诸塞州城市（英国也有同名城市）

expressions.example_src: Mince two cloves of garlic.
expressions.example_parallel: Mince the garlic as fine as you can. — 蒜尽量剁细。

expressions.gloss_cn: 小火慢炖，冒小泡但不滚
expressions.example_src: Let it simmer for twenty minutes.
expressions.example_parallel: Bring it to a boil, then let it simmer. — 先烧开再转小火炖。

expressions.example_src: Do three sets of ten reps.
expressions.example_parallel: Last two reps, push! — 最后两个，顶住！

expressions.gloss_cn: 酸、不爽（输了或被比下去）
expressions.example_src: He's still salty about losing that bet.
expressions.example_parallel: Don't be salty, it was a fair game. — 别酸了，比赛很公平。

expressions.example_src: Avocados are dirt cheap right now.
expressions.example_parallel: Got it dirt cheap at a garage sale. — 车库甩卖淘的，超便宜。

expressions.intent_cn: 说有别的因素搅乱了结论
expressions.example_src: Age may confound the link between income and health.
expressions.example_parallel: A confounding variable. — 混杂变量。

qa_log.q: confound 在论文里和日常的 confuse 一样吗？
qa_log.a: 不一样。研究语境里 confound 指第三个变量同时影响自变量和因变量，让你没法下因果结论，名词是 confounder。

expressions.gloss_cn: 改天吧（婉拒邀约）；原指缺货时的补购凭证
expressions.example_src: Can I take a rain check on dinner?
expressions.example_parallel: Rain check? I'm wiped. — 改天行吗？我累瘫了。

expressions.gloss_cn: 跟车太近；也指比赛前在停车场开派对
expressions.example_src: The guy behind me was tailgating the whole way.
expressions.example_parallel: Stop tailgating, you'll rear-end him. — 别跟这么近，会追尾。

qa_log.q: tailgate party 和开车的 tailgate 是一个词吗？
qa_log.a: 同一个词。tailgate 本义是皮卡后挡板，开车跟太近是贴着人家后挡板，派对是在停车场打开后挡板吃喝。

expressions.example_src: Curls mostly work your biceps.
expressions.example_parallel: He flexed his biceps for the photo. — 他拍照时秀了一下二头肌。

expressions.example_src: Cutting funding would exacerbate the problem.
expressions.example_parallel: Stress can exacerbate symptoms. — 压力会加重症状。

expressions.example_src: That place is a bit pricey for lunch.
expressions.example_parallel: Nice, but pricey. — 好是好，就是贵。

expressions.gloss_cn: 大扫除，连犄角旮旯一起彻底打扫

expressions.example_parallel: We do a deep clean every spring. — 我们每年春天大扫除一次。

expressions.example_src: He went to Turkey for a hair transplant.

expressions.example_src: I'm a total night owl, I do my best work at 1 a.m.
expressions.example_parallel: Night owls hate 8 a.m. meetings. — 夜猫子最恨早上八点的会。

expressions.gloss_cn: 床底下一团一团的灰球
expressions.example_src: There are dust bunnies the size of my fist under the bed.
expressions.example_parallel: Found three dust bunnies and a sock under the couch. — 沙发底下扫出三团灰和一只袜子。

expressions.example_src: I'll put up a PR tonight.
expressions.example_parallel: Can you review my PR? — 帮我看下 PR？

expressions.note: 洛杉矶的 June Gloom 就是这个

expressions.example_parallel: Overcast but no rain. — 阴天但没下雨。

expressions.intent_cn: 发消息时缓和语气说实话

expressions.example_parallel: tbh I forgot. — 说实话我忘了。

expressions.example_parallel: I got into a fender bender in the parking lot. — 在停车场蹭了一下。

expressions.example_src: I'm so stoked for the concert.
expressions.example_parallel: Stoked you could make it! — 你能来太好了！

expressions.gloss_cn: 洗脑神曲、脑子里单曲循环的旋律
expressions.example_src: That jingle is such an earworm.
expressions.example_parallel: Thanks for the earworm. — 谢谢你让我被洗脑。

expressions.example_src: Can you pass me the peeler? These carrots are filthy.
expressions.example_parallel: Grab the peeler from the second drawer. — 削皮刀在第二个抽屉。

expressions.example_src: Buy one, get one free on all candles.
expressions.example_parallel: The sign said buy one, get one free. — 牌子上写着买一送一。

expressions.example_src: I can't come, I'm broke until Friday.
expressions.example_parallel: Student life: always broke. — 学生生活：永远没钱。

expressions.example_src: She's been burning the midnight oil before finals.
expressions.example_parallel: Burning the midnight oil again? — 又开夜车？

expressions.gloss_cn: 技术债（为了赶工留下的坑）
expressions.example_src: We need a sprint just to pay down tech debt.
expressions.example_parallel: That hack is tech debt we'll regret. — 这个临时方案以后要还的。

expressions.example_src: We've got a clogged drain in the shower.
expressions.example_parallel: Hair is the number one cause of a clogged drain. — 头发是下水道堵的头号原因。

expressions.example_src: Good teachers go the extra mile for their students.
expressions.example_parallel: She always goes the extra mile. — 她总是多付出一些。

expressions.gloss_cn: 粘毛滚筒（粘衣服上的猫毛）
expressions.example_src: I keep a lint roller in my car for the cat hair.
expressions.example_parallel: Hit your coat with the lint roller. — 用粘毛器滚一下外套。

expressions.example_src: I'm bummed I missed the game.
expressions.example_parallel: Bummed it rained. — 下雨了，好扫兴。

expressions.gloss_cn: 不在办公室（邮件自动回复的说法）
expressions.example_src: I am currently out of office with limited access to email.
expressions.example_parallel: Set your out-of-office reply before you leave. — 走之前设一下自动回复。

expressions.example_src: The kitchen sink is backed up again.
expressions.example_parallel: Don't pour grease down there, the sink'll back up. — 别往里倒油，水槽会堵。

expressions.example_src: I'm still jet-lagged from the flight.
expressions.example_parallel: Jet-lagged and starving at 4 a.m. — 时差没倒，凌晨四点饿醒。

expressions.example_src: Chest and bis today.
expressions.example_parallel: Bis and tris on Friday. — 周五练二头三头。

expressions.example_src: Don't merge until CI is green.
expressions.example_parallel: Merge it after lunch. — 午饭后合。

expressions.gloss_cn: 不骗你、说真的（not gonna lie）
expressions.example_src: ngl that was kind of impressive
expressions.example_parallel: ngl I cried. — 说真的我哭了。
